name: Fountain
description: Fountain (owner 14 Nov 2026, 2×2, Housing): a stone fountain for the houses around it.

variants.name: Octagonal stone fountain 0° (front-right)
variants.notes: Owner's render (14 Nov 2026): octagonal stone basin on steps with a raised bowl, a bronze spout and four jets. The dirt patch under it is cut away so it sits on the terrain or paving. View 0° (front-right), cut out of the owner's render and scaled to 0.145 wide and 0.128 high (the render's view is a little steeper than the game's). Front corner of the plinth set by hand; this view is the one the game uses.
